_comment_flags: What each Anki flag colour means to YOU, and whether the mining modes may touch it. `ignore: true` makes a flag off-limits to `replace_search --flag N` and `replace_apply --rehab-flag N` unless --force-ignored-flag is passed — use it for flags that mark cards which must never be swept into a mining run. Leave this map empty ({}) if you have no flag conventions.

1.meaning: triage — something is wrong; diagnose it

2.meaning: flesh out — bare card, needs building up

7.meaning: tutoring lessons — record only, never mine
